title: 1.2.25 typeof Round-Up
description: Run typeof over six different values and find the one answer that lies. Auto-graded.

steps.title: A string and a number
steps.instructions: Log the type of a piece of text and the type of a number.

steps.title: A boolean and an undefined
steps.instructions: Log the type of true, and the type of undefined.

steps.title: null
steps.instructions: Log the type of null. Watch the answer: it is the one that lies.

steps.title: An object
steps.instructions: Log the type of an object written with curly braces, such as { name: "Sarah" }.

requirements.title: typeof a string
requirements.description: Logs the type of a quoted piece of text, either inline or via a variable holding one

requirements.title: typeof a number
requirements.description: Logs the type of a plain number, either inline or via a variable holding one

requirements.title: typeof true
requirements.description: Logs the type of a boolean, either inline or via a variable holding true/false

requirements.title: typeof undefined
requirements.description: Logs the type of undefined, either inline or via a variable left unassigned

requirements.title: typeof null
requirements.description: Logs the type of null: the answer that is a known bug: either inline or via a variable holding null

requirements.title: typeof an object
requirements.description: Logs the type of an object written with curly braces, either inline or via a variable holding one
